scope: Terminal audit disposition, not a completed scientific evidence set or DecisionState

cases.reason: The accessible report claims ERAP1 interaction at cellular and protein levels. Unavailable methods are needed to distinguish intact-cell engagement from lysate binding or indirect functional effects, and to evaluate exposure matching and controls. Credible intact-cell engagement could change the baseline critical uncertainty; a lysate-only or unmatched assay would not establish it. These alternatives cannot defensibly be adjudicated from the accessible material.
cases.not_a_claim: This is not proof that the inaccessible results would overturn the baseline, nor a negative finding about engagement.

cases.reason: The public supplement supports bounded biochemical observations, not verified cellular engagement. Main-text absence limits chemical-identity mapping, assay interpretation and broader mechanistic assessment. It is not independently shown to change the baseline decision.
constraints: Do not compute selectivity ratios across different substrates
Do not treat calculated interaction energies as measured binding
Do not infer absence of cellular experiments from their absence in the supplement
